trigger.ie_path: Create PDR > PDI > SDF Filter > Flow Description
trigger.field: Integer overflow in ogs_pfcp_parse_sdf_filter() yields a malformed/empty rule; ogs_ipfw_compile_rule() then strcmp()s a NULL token -> SEGV

ground_truth.crash_type: SEGV / NULL-pointer READ in strcmp (DEADLYSIGNAL, address 0x0)

root_cause.note: Integer overflow in SDF filter parsing (per issue title) produces the malformed rule consumed downstream. IMPORTANT: shares crash function with OPEN5GS-PFCP-001 (#3840) but is a DISTINCT bug — 001 is a WRITE buffer overflow at ogs-ipfw.c:83; this is a NULL-deref READ at ogs-ipfw.c:64. Disambiguate matches on line + crash_type, not function alone.
